requiredBehaviors.requirement: Explicit audience and sensitivity decisions are closed and deny by default; restricted and highly restricted evidence cannot widen its audience.

Preview separates included and excluded links before immutable publication and requires exact purpose, snapshot digest, and projection version.
Attestation is a local recorded, purpose-bound assertion over one manifest and scope snapshot; it never asserts identity verification, legal signature, or nonrepudiation.
Supersession and void are append-only semantic states; released values and snapshots are never rewritten or merged.
